newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity options Jan-Sep volume up 13 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity options Jan-Sep volume up 13 pct yr/yr.

text.p: U.S. equity options volume in the first nine months of the year rose 13 percent to 144,795,367 contracts, from 128,617,083 contracts in the first nine months of 1995, the Options Industry Council said Thursday.
September volume rose 2.6 percent, to 15,144,575 contracts, from 14,759,611 contracts in September 1995, the industry group said in a statement.
The group said the volume trend puts the industry on track to post record volume for the second straight year.
Average daily volume in September was 757,229 contracts. -Derivatives desk, 312-408-8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com
